Sinha joins Instamart after serving as the Chief Executive Officer of Myntra. Over a career spanning more than two decades, she has held leadership positions across Myntra, Flipkart, Britannia Industries and Hindustan Unilever, building consumer businesses across fashion, e-commerce and FMCG. The appointment comes amid a series of leadership changes at Swiggy since its public listing.

Earlier departures have included Company Secretary and Compliance Officer M. Sridhar, Independent Director Sahil Barua, nominee directors Sumer Juneja, Anand Daniel and Roger Clark Rabalais, co-founder Lakshmi Nandan Reddy Obul, as well as senior Instamart executives Ankit Jain and Hari Kumar. Sinha will take charge of Instamart from August 3, 2026, succeeding Amitesh Kumar Jha, who resigned from the company to pursue opportunities outside Swiggy.

Sinha stepped down from her position at Myntra in April 2026, when Flipkart appointed Sharon Pais to lead the fashion business. Her move to Instamart now places her back in a high-growth consumer technology business, although in a market with a very different operating model from fashion e-commerce.

The leadership change comes at an important time for Instamart, which is competing aggressively with Blinkit, Zepto and other fast-growing quick-commerce businesses. The sector has expanded rapidly in India as consumers increasingly use apps to order groceries, household products, electronics and other everyday items for rapid delivery. Swiggy’s decision to bring Sinha into the role reflects the company’s focus on strengthening Instamart’s next phase of growth.

Instamart, launched in 2020, has expanded to more than 131 cities across India. The platform faces intense competition from Blinkit, owned by Eternal, and Zepto, while Amazon and Flipkart are also increasing their focus on quick-commerce services and expanding into smaller cities. The competitive environment makes Sinha’s experience in scaling consumer businesses particularly relevant. Swiggy will need to balance growth with operational efficiency while continuing to attract customers and increase the range of products available through Instamart.
